data.title: How do I access course materials?
data.body:
All course materials are available in the Content section of D2L. You can access readings, videos, and assignments by navigating through the module structure.

If you have trouble accessing any materials, please contact your instructor.

data.title: When are assignments due?
data.body:
Assignment due dates are listed in the Assignments section and in each module's overview page. All times are in Eastern Time (ET).

Late submissions may incur a penalty as outlined in the syllabus.

data.title: How do I participate in discussions?
data.body:
Go to the Discussions section in D2L. Each module has designated discussion topics.

  • Read the prompt carefully
  • Post your initial response by the first deadline
  • Reply to at least two classmates by the second deadline

data.title: What are the technical requirements?
data.body:
You'll need:

  • A reliable internet connection
  • An updated web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge)
  • Speakers or headphones for video content
  • A webcam and microphone if required for presentations

For detailed system requirements, visit the UGA eLearning Technical Support page.

data.title: Who do I contact for help?
data.body:
Course content questions: Contact your instructor via D2L email

Technical issues: Contact UGA eLearning Support at support@uga.edu

General university questions: Visit uga.edu
